level1.title: Four Parts of the Mass
level1.story: The Mass has four parts. We gather in God's name. We listen to God's Word. We receive Jesus. Then we are sent out to love our neighbor and share the Good News!
level1.keyLine: We gather, listen, receive, and go!
level1.heartIntro: Draw or write how you will take part in this part of the Mass next Sunday.
questions: What are the four parts of the Mass?
How can we share Jesus after Mass this week?
level1.prayer: Jesus, thank You for the gift of the Mass. Send me out to love and serve You. Amen.

level2.title: Four Parts of the Mass
level2.story: The Mass has four main parts. In the Introductory Rites, we gather and begin "In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit." In the Liturgy of the Word, we listen to God's Word from the Bible. In the Liturgy of the Eucharist, bread and wine become Jesus' Body and Blood, and we receive Jesus in Holy Communion. In the Concluding Rites, the priest blesses us and sends us out: "Go in peace." We answer, "Thanks be to God!" Mass does not really end at the church door. Jesus sends us to love our neighbor and share the Gospel all week long.
